triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '5. Allocating workspace in the hot path' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 5. Allocating workspace in the hot path

problem.statement: NVFP4 Split-K GEMV Pitfalls -- 5. Allocating workspace in the hot path

payload.attempted: Allocate `(S, N)` FP32 workspace inside every call for simplicity.
payload.lesson: Cache workspace by `N` and device, and keep allocation outside the measured hot path.

established_fact.mechanism: Split-K adds a real workspace dependency. Its lifetime must be stable across graph capture and replay.

payload.observed: Allocation jitter pollutes TPOT and can break CUDA Graph capture or make replay results incomparable.
payload.root_cause: Split-K adds a real workspace dependency. Its lifetime must be stable across graph capture and replay.
